name: codex_dogfood
scope: Composite historical case collection, not one completed experiment. Individual Stage D reports retain their own outcomes; sealed and unfinished case material is not reopened or interpreted by this inventory.
restoration: Extract the verified packet into this directory; verify each file SHA-256 against this manifest. For committed inputs, use git show <revision>:experiments/<name>/<path>. Restore dependent packets together. Do not execute models or inspect sealed inputs without separate authority.
retention_reason: Frozen inputs, cross-experiment dependencies and deterministic replay addresses are preserved. Archives are not execution grants.
